task_summary: Write a Node.js script to load a Three.js object definition, apply Y-up to Z-up coordinate transformation, and export it as a Wavefront OBJ file for Blender
decomposition_rationale: This is a focused pipeline task with a single clear workflow: load Three.js scene → apply coordinate transform → export OBJ. All steps are tightly coupled and share the same Three.js/Node.js context, so a single skill covering the entire export pipeline is most appropriate to avoid artificial boundaries.

skills.name: evo-threejs-obj-export
skills.description: Generates a Node.js ES module script that dynamically imports a Three.js object definition file, constructs a scene graph, applies a -90° X-rotation for Y-up to Z-up coordinate conversion (Blender compatibility), forces world matrix updates in the headless environment, serializes the scene to Wavefront OBJ format using OBJExporter, and writes the result to disk.
skills.responsibility: Handle the complete pipeline: dynamic import of the Three.js object.js file, scene graph construction, coordinate system transformation (Y-up → Z-up via -π/2 X-rotation), explicit matrixWorld update, OBJ serialization via OBJExporter, and file I/O to write the .obj output
dr_sections: 2. The OBJExporter Module: API and Internal Mechanics
4. Coordinate System Transformations: Aligning Y-Up with Z-Up
5. Dynamic Evaluation and Ingestion of Scene Files
6. File System I/O and Output Generation
